config.restoration_note: v2 (control zero fraction + additive mean match) adopted in cycle 1 on dev; pre and v1 are reported alongside
config.sensitivity_space: training-only PCA50 of the standardised genes
config.generators: not trained (gate R3-0 G1 failed): ddpm_abs, ddpm_resid, cellflow -> numbers left blank

mean_model.rule: lowest 3-fold CV condition RMSE among Ridge-type and MLP candidates, TRAIN drugs only

evaluation.name: post-freeze evaluation on a reused public benchmark
evaluation.setting: final: fit on all 209 TRAIN drug groups (all eligible cell lines); score TEST drug groups once
evaluation.unused: the prior study's 70 VALIDATION drug groups are used by no step of this study
evaluation.exposure: Tahoe-100M is public and this project reported test scores on this split before (chemCPA study); this is not a blind cohort
evaluation.metric: per-well unbiased (U-statistic) energy distance, Euclidean, genes / training within-well SD (floor at 10th percentile), no clipping; wells -> condition -> drug, equal weights; drug-block bootstrap 2000, seed 20261117
evaluation.n_rule: n = min(observed cells, same-plate control cells, 64); wells with n < 32 dropped
evaluation.hcc_target: SNU-423 (CVCL_0366) reported separately; HepG2/C3A is not called adult HCC

generator_status: absolute DDPM, residual DDPM and CellFlow are NOT trained: gate R3-0 (G1) failed, generator claim on hold (reports/anchored_distribution_r3/DECISIONS.md)
